origin: cwe/502/php Taint Sinks: unserialize() on external data

finding.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
finding.summary: A cart cookie is base64-decoded and passed directly to unserialize(), allowing attacker-controlled serialized objects to instantiate PHP classes and magic methods.

trap: Adding allowed_classes only after calling unserialize(), trusting base64 as validation, or signing the value after deserialization. Prefer a JSON cart format; if legacy serialized data must be supported temporarily, verify an HMAC before deserialization and restrict allowed classes.
must_preserve: Unsigned attacker-controlled cookies no longer reach unserialize(). Empty or invalid cookies still restore an empty cart, and legitimate cart data still returns items and coupon fields in the same array shape.
